notes: SYNTHETIC fixture pack: deterministic Choose-journey shapes that prove the Vouch pipeline (adapter protocol v1, metering, sealing, failure semantics). They are NOT evidence of model or product improvement; every scenario is invented data with example.com sources. Real journeys require a Choose-owned runner (docs/choose-integration-gaps.md).

W-C1.name: Preparation and clarification
W-C1.notes: Ambiguous budget currency asked non-skippably; market gate inline and never inferred; paid research not triggered during preparation.

W-C2.name: Find shortlist
W-C2.notes: Mandatory-condition verdicts with citation spans; one targeted clarification; sourced no-fit with bounded wording.

W-C3.name: Compare
W-C3.notes: Input-order candidate coverage, missing-info expression, blocked-source placeholder without substitution.

W-C4.name: Setup plan
W-C4.notes: Connection support with sourced/rule basis, whole-set budget verdict, buying order; incompatible-critical-connection no-fit with swap offer.

W-C5.name: Follow-up revision
W-C5.notes: Child version linked to parent digest; failed revision keeps the prior answer intact.

W-C6.name: Cross-task handoff
W-C6.notes: Find selection prefills Compare; Compare rejects become Find exclusions (instructions, never examined options); credentials never inherited.

W-C7.name: Save, reopen and resume
W-C7.notes: Draft restore, resume from pause, per-report capabilities; locale switch preserves the original report language (en/CN cross cell).

W-C8.name: Exception journeys
W-C8.notes: Insufficient sources, overrun (stall, killed by the controller), cumulative-budget exhaustion without endless resume, buyer stop with released hold.

W-C9.name: Product-control boundaries (regression-only)
W-C9.notes: Regression guardrails, never autonomous optimization targets: visible storage failure without silent loss; credit hold released on failing work.

guardrailFamilies.name: Access and account boundaries
guardrailFamilies.notes: Login/account gating is verified by Choose's own account and identity suites (choose-website tests/account*.test.ts, identity*.test.ts); Vouch-side fixture pending a Choose-owned runner. Regression-only.

guardrailFamilies.name: Payment and credit invariants
guardrailFamilies.notes: Hold release on failure, idempotency, no debit for unbilled outcomes. Real payment/credit behavior is Choose's own payments/credits suites; regression-only.

guardrailFamilies.name: Security and capability isolation
guardrailFamilies.notes: Run-capability isolation, public-HTTPS source validation, DNS-checked media transport are Choose's own suites (page-inspect, media-route, research-routes tests); not exercisable by Vouch fixtures and never an optimization target.

guardrailFamilies.name: Browser storage integrity
guardrailFamilies.notes: Visible storage failure, exportable draft, bounded sessions. Regression-only.
